features.title: Serving the
features.description: GoomuFuloWiɗto fulfills three main missions: writing the Dictionary, defending the Pulaar language, and patronage through literary prizes.

institution.title: The Institution
institution.description: Founded for the Pulaar language, GoomuFuloWiɗto is an organization of language guardians.

dictionary.title: The Dictionary
dictionary.description: GoomuFuloWiɗto is developing the Dictionary, the reference work of the Pulaar language.

prizes.title: The Prizes
prizes.description: Each year, GoomuFuloWiɗto awards literary prizes and various awards.

immortals.title: Scholars
immortals.description: Elected members make up GoomuFuloWiɗto, guardians of language and culture.

sayDontSay.title: Say,
sayDontSay.intro: Which words, which phrases to choose, keep or reject? GoomuFuloWiɗto guides you in the correct use of the Pulaar language.

dictionary.title: The
dictionary.intro: The GoomuFuloWiɗto Dictionary is the reference work for Pulaar usage. Consult it online.

footer.description: GoomuFuloWiɗto is an organization dedicated to defining the Pulaar language through its dictionary.
